title: First-run detection: a principal with no completion state sees the tour; a principal with completion state does not
iWant: the tour to open only on my first run, not on every visit
soThat: I am not re-onboarded on every session and the surface stays clean

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a principal whose completion-state store contains no completion record for the applied blueprint set version, the tour auto-opens on the highest-value surface; given a principal whose completion-state store contains a completion record for the applied blueprint set version, the tour does NOT auto-open and only the checklist and the restart-tour control render. The check is documented as a mechanism-reach gap in the README (not directly probed at runtime; enforced by the fixture branch under manual boot for the gate reviewer).

A completion record with an unknown or unparseable tourVersion is treated as absent: the tour surfaces as first-run and the console log carries data-error=COMPLETION_RECORD_UNPARSEABLE naming the record id; no false dismissal is inherited.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a completion record whose tourVersion cannot be parsed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tour opens as first-run and data-error=COMPLETION_RECORD_UNPARSEABLE is logged
